profile.manufacturing_ethos: An Italian off-road powerhouse, Airoh helmets are the choice of motocross and enduro world champions. Known for featherweight carbon shells, aggressive aerodynamics, and uncompromising protection that performs under the most extreme riding conditions.
profile.helmet_types: Full Face, Motocross, Adventure, Modular, Carbon Fiber
profile.story:
Airoh was founded in 1968 by Luigi and Franco Airoh in the small town of Casale Monferrato, Italy, initially producing motorcycle accessories before focusing entirely on helmets. The brand quickly gained a reputation for innovation and craftsmanship, becoming one of the first European manufacturers to adopt advanced safety standards and aerodynamic designs that prioritized rider protection without compromising style.

Over the decades, Airoh has been instrumental in advancing helmet safety technology, notably pioneering the use of multi-density EPS liners and integrating communication systems early on. Their commitment to rigorous testing and collaboration with racing teams ensured that their helmets consistently met or exceeded FIM regulations, establishing a legacy where Italian design excellence meets uncompromising safety performance.

brand_heritage_matrix.engineering_philosophy: Advanced Protective Shell Technology & Rider Ergonomic Comfort

qualitative_brand_identity.brand_reputation_summary: Airoh is globally recognized for its commitment to rider safety, aerodynamic innovation, and precision helmet manufacturing.
qualitative_brand_identity.editorial_brand_verdict: With decades of motorsport heritage, Airoh consistently produces helmets that exceed global safety standards (ECE 22.06, DOT, FIM) while maintaining rider comfort.
